html:
SMTO-JOB-0015 — Only part of the job's output was shown

GUID: f0fd7eb7-e80d-4ec8-b28c-144b5e33c43f
Slug: job-output-incomplete
Domain: JOB · Subsystem: job

What happened

  • This reply shows only part of what the background job printed. The rest may still be in the job's saved log, so you can read it without running anything again.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask the agent to show the rest of the output, for example "read the rest of the output from that job". The remaining output is kept with the job, so the agent can read it page by page.
  2. Do not rerun the command just to see the missing output. Running it again would repeat whatever the command does, and the new output might not match the first run.
  3. If the agent says part of the log was shortened or removed, ask it to summarize what it can still read. Very long logs can be cut down, so some lines may no longer be available.

What success looks like

  • The agent shows the rest of the output, or tells you there is nothing more to read.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't run the command again to get its output.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The job receipt reported output_complete=false with a job_id, so the observation attached a hint to read the remaining captured output from that job's existing log.

What this means

  • Observation sees output_complete:false with a job_id and attaches the existing-log recovery hint, independently of whether the job's final state is established. Job identity, supervision and dispatch/terminal receipts own effect truth. Diagnostics do not launch, cancel or replay work; missing output or failed control does not prove that the original process stopped.

Why this can happen

  • Observation sees output_complete:false with a job_id and attaches the existing-log recovery hint, independently of whether the job's final state is established.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the original job state and output_next_offset separately; missing output is not a reason to rerun the command.

How to fix it

  • Call manage_job with action=logs, the same job_id and output_next_offset (or offset=0 if absent), paging until the log is exhausted; keep any log_truncated or log_purged facts in the answer. Do not rerun the command to recover missing output.
  • Read the existing job logs using its exact ID and next output offset, or offset zero when absent; do not rerun the command.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Bounded reads of the same job's retained log recover available output and preserve any truncation/incompleteness facts.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Job identity, supervision and dispatch/terminal receipts own effect truth. Diagnostics do not launch, cancel or replay work; missing output or failed control does not prove that the original process stopped.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
